pages.title: Void Lattice Singularity
pages.text: Void lattice crushed into one point. It is made of crystallised emptiness, and compressing nothing turns out to yield something very strange. The point is hard to look at, because there is nothing there to focus on.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Void lattice is a crystal of the vacuum. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor, I expected nothing; I got a point that seemed to absorb its surroundings.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
